tools.name: autocomplete_regions
tools.description: Suggest holiday regions by (partial) name, typo-tolerant. Names are matched in the response language, with German (the native names, e.g. "Seenplatte") always accepted as well. Returns region ids usable as regionId in search_accommodations, with accommodation counts.

tools.name: search_accommodations
tools.description: Paginated holiday accommodation search over directly bookable/inquirable own inventory (externally managed listings are not exposed). tools.name: get_accommodation
tools.description: Full localized detail of one accommodation: description, location with coordinates, capacity, rating, feature codes, image gallery, base price, and `url` (the listing page on the website of the locale).

tools.name: get_accommodation_availability
tools.description: Per-day availability for one accommodation: bookable days, arrival/departure flags, minimum stay, nightly price and discounts. Window defaults to today and is capped at 24 months.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_accommodations" is 1690 chars, far longer than this server's median (235). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
